name: Towakoku
source:
Main character starts to live alone after entering university. One day he watches girl Setsuna dying in a traffic accident. He uses his awakened ability to turn back time to help the girl and discover what's hidden behind disappearances in the town. Protagonist's important people start to get involved. At the same time all these crimes push him to commit atrocities himself...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
